name: cwv-cases
purpose: CWV rig cases that equip CWV Blacksmith seeds. modded_progression is deliberately absent: its fresh-profile route answers get_item_from_id from its own view only, which hides MoreItemsLibrary seeds. cosmetics_tweaker supplies the embedded MoreItemsLibrary. Sibling of exec-cim's cim-guard-cases plan (same mod set). regression_suites runs every loaded /<mod>_regression_test right after smoke-keep, because T.expect_rt reads rows echoed earlier in the boot (tools/harness/driver/vt2_rig_driver.lua:728-740). Timeout 600: the case timeouts alone sum to 420 s (60 + 240 + 120).
